s1.syndrome_frame: Hypertension with multisystem involvement and vascular abnormalities
salient_findings: Continuous murmur in the epigastric region
High-grade ostial stenosis of the left renal, celiac trunk, and superior mesenteric arteries
key_facts: Medical history includes bone and central diabetes insipidus
Liver involvement was treated with cytarabine for one year
Untreated dyslipidemia with LDL cholesterol 3.11 mmol/L
Transthoracic echocardiogram shows left ventricular mass index of 110 g/m²
Abdominal CT angiogram shows right kidney atrophy and high-grade ostial stenosis of the left renal, celiac trunk, and superior mesenteric arteries

shortlist.label: Fibromuscular dysplasia
shortlist.why_kept: High-grade ostial stenosis of the left renal, celiac trunk, and superior mesenteric arteries

shortlist.label: Takayasu arteritis
shortlist.why_kept: Multisystem involvement and vascular abnormalities, including high-grade ostial stenosis

shortlist.label: Atherosclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: Untreated dyslipidemia and high blood pressure, increasing the risk of atherosclerotic disease

shortlist.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
shortlist.why_kept: Multisystem involvement, including kidney atrophy and high-grade ostial stenosis

shortlist.label: Moyamoya disease
shortlist.why_kept: Vascular abnormalities, including high-grade ostial stenosis, and potential for cerebral involvement

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with difficult-to-treat hypertension, high-grade ostial stenosis of the left renal artery, and absence of inflammatory markers or other systemic symptoms is most consistent with fibromuscular dysplasia, a non-atherosclerotic, non-inflammatory vascular disease that often affects the renal and internal carotid arteries.

rejected.label: Takayasu arteritis
rejected.why: Lack of inflammatory markers and systemic symptoms

rejected.label: Atherosclerosis
rejected.why: Patient's age and absence of typical atherosclerotic risk factors such as smoking or diabetes

rejected.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
rejected.why: Absence of systemic symptoms and inflammatory markers

rejected.label: Moyamoya disease
rejected.why: Primarily affects the cerebral vasculature, not consistent with the patient's renal artery stenosis
